List of known channelers that needed to learn the use of the [[One Power]] from another channeler, unlike the channelers with the [[spark]] who started the use by themselves. In this list are categorized also the ''[[sul'dam]]'' that are learners even if they don't want to channel directly and people that are clearly described with the potential to learn, as the female members of the [[Al'Vere]] family.
